operational_nodes.name: ClippyJsonDiagnosticGate
operational_nodes.doc: Invokes cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --message-format=json using std::path / camino and ./clippy.toml (too-many-lines-threshold = 80, too-many-arguments-threshold = 5, disallowed-types) and parses structured compiler-message payloads.

operational_nodes.name: RaSyntaxCstAttributeVerifier
operational_nodes.doc: Parses .rs files into lossless ra_ap_syntax::SourceFile CSTs (zero hand-rolled lexers, zero rustc_private) to audit #![forbid(...)], #![deny(...)], and forbidden #[allow(...)] / cfg_attr attributes.

operational_nodes.name: ModularSlocRatchetEnforcer
operational_nodes.doc: Computes executable SLOC directly from lossless CST non-trivia tokens, enforcing < 380 target SLOC, <= 500 hard executable SLOC ceiling, and monotonic downward legacy ratchet convergence to 0.

operational_nodes.name: CrossPlatformTestTargetEnforcer
operational_nodes.doc: Enforces identical forbid lint discipline across unit tests (#[cfg(test)]) and integration tests (tests/ *.rs) with CRLF/LF normalization across macOS, Linux, and Windows.
